setup_additional_logging: setup ATen and NCCL logging to a log file in the given folder for the current SLURM job and rank
log_git_status: log the git commit hash of an LCM core repo and check for uncommitted changes
log_lcm_environment: log git commit hashes for all four LCM core repos for traceability and reproducibility
log_env_variables: log SLURM, NCCL, CUDA, and Fairseq2 environment variables along with device info for debugging
review_logging_module: review the logging module functions for setup, git status, environment logging, and variable dumping
